programs.title: Flip Or Flop
programs.desc: Tarek and Christina team up with their friend Pete De Best on a house in Yorba Linda, CA. They've flipped houses with Pete, but he's a major penny pincher, and they must convince him that you have to spend money to make money.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.desc: A first time buyer has her sights set on historic row homes in Philadelphia. Her college friend and agent, however, struggles to get her to accept what houses actually cost in the current market.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.desc: A couple has made the decision to buy a home in the windy city of Chicago, so they're on the hunt for an ideal home, but while she wants a loft in the downtown area, he prefers a family home with a yard in a quiet suburban neighborhood.

programs.title: Building Roots
programs.sub_title: Pink Is Not in Their Vocabulary
programs.desc: A couple purchased a home with incredible mountain views, but the pink stucco siding creates the wrong kind of wow factor. Ben and Cristi open the home to enhance the surrounding landscape, using natural materials.

programs.title: The Garden Gurus
programs.desc: Autumn is in full swing and the gurus have some great advice for you. Bonnie teaches all about soil recovery and has a perfect project, Nigel rejuvenates your garden, and Trevor continues his European journey in Austria.

programs.title: The Block
programs.desc: Tonight it's a Block wedding when 2012 contestants Brad and Lara get married. Everyone enjoys a night off from renovating followed by a leisurely lunch with Scotty. But he and Shelley have a surprise challenge and its fans v faves.
